## Primary Services
- Carpet Cleaning — professional hot water extraction for carpets and embedded soil. https://tegcarpetfurniturecleaning.com/service-carpet-cleaning.html
- Tile & Grout Cleaning — cleaning for tile surfaces and grout lines. https://tegcarpetfurniturecleaning.com/service-tile-grout.html
- Upholstery / Couch Cleaning — cleaning for sofas, sectionals, chairs, and other fabric furniture. https://tegcarpetfurniturecleaning.com/service-couch-cleaning.html
- Area Rug Cleaning — fiber-appropriate cleaning for area rugs, including many wool, synthetic, and oriental-style rugs. https://tegcarpetfurniturecleaning.com/service-area-rug.html
- Pet Odor & Stain Removal — treatment for pet accidents, urine odor, and carpet stains. https://tegcarpetfurniturecleaning.com/service-stain-removal.html
- Steam Cleaning — steam/hot-water extraction cleaning for applicable carpets and surfaces. https://tegcarpetfurniturecleaning.com/service-steam-cleaning.html
- Commercial Carpet Cleaning — cleaning for offices, retail, and other commercial/high-traffic spaces. https://tegcarpetfurniturecleaning.com/service-commercial.html
- Water Damage Restoration — water extraction and drying for affected carpets and floors after leaks or floods. https://tegcarpetfurniturecleaning.com/service-water-damage.html
- Carpet Stretching & Repair — correction of wrinkles, buckling, and some loose seams when the carpet remains serviceable. https://tegcarpetfurniturecleaning.com/service-carpet-stretching.html
- Hardwood Floor Cleaning — controlled-moisture, finish-conscious cleaning for sealed hardwood. https://tegcarpetfurniturecleaning.com/service-hardwood.html

## Important Facts
- T.E.G states it is available 24/7.
- Pricing is agreed before work starts; the site does not publish one universal carpet-cleaning price.
- Most carpet is stated to dry in about 4–8 hours, depending on thickness, humidity, and airflow.
- Carpet cleaning uses professional hot water extraction / steam cleaning.
- Pet odor and urine treatment is offered as a dedicated service.
- Commercial carpet cleaning is offered for offices and other commercial spaces.
- Water-damage service focuses on extraction and drying for affected carpets and floors.
- Carpet stretching and repair is intended for wrinkles, buckling, and some loose seams when the carpet remains serviceable.
- Hardwood cleaning uses controlled moisture and finish-conscious methods for sealed floors.
